articles.summary: Sudden cardiac arrest impacts people of all ages, and each year, 7,000 children and teens are affected.1 While the focus is often on student-athletes, research shows that sudden cardiac arrest is more common among non-athlete students in school settings.
articles.title: Saving young hearts: AED placement strategies for K-12 schools
